title: Reading at the zipper frontier
statement: For every alphabet $A$, integer frontier $z$, and finite possibly blank-symbol stacks $l,r$, the two-stack tape with frontier $z$, left stack $l$, and right stack $r$ has at position $z$ the first entry of $r$, or blank if $r$ is empty.
replaced:
Let $z$ be an integer and let $l$ and $r$ be finite lists of possibly-blank
symbols over an alphabet $A$. The two-stack zipper tape with frontier $z$,
left stack $l$, and right stack $r$ reads, at position $z$, exactly the first
entry of $r$ — or blank when $r$ is empty.
